privacy:
1. Overview

paste-co.de ("we", "our", "the site") is a project archive and community platform operated for educational purposes. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data we collect, why we collect it, how it is stored, and your rights. By using the site you agree to the practices described below. If you do not agree, please stop using the site.

2. Data We Collect

When you log in with Discord we receive, via OAuth 2.0, the following data directly from Discord:

  • Discord user ID, username, and display name
  • Avatar image URL (hosted on Discord's CDN)
  • Email address (used only for account identification, never displayed publicly)
  • Guild (server) membership and role information for the MacroStack server

This information is stored in our database and associated with activity you take on the site (favorites, forum posts, submissions).

When you browse anonymously your IP address is immediately hashed using HMAC-SHA256 with a server-side secret. The raw IP address is never stored. The resulting hash is truncated to 16 hex characters and stored in our activity and view logs solely for deduplication and abuse prevention purposes. The hash cannot be reversed to recover your IP address.

When you submit a project we store your Discord identity (see above), the submitted file URL and full project metadata, and your IP hash. Submissions go into an admin review queue before being published.

Usage data — we count project views and downloads per project. A 10-minute deduplication window is applied using your IP hash. No detailed browsing profiles are built.

Community feedback — source reputation votes, comments, quick comments, reports, anonymous display names, and logged-in Discord attribution may be stored so admins can moderate source quality and abuse reports.

3. Third-Party Services

Discord OAuth & APIAuthentication, profile data, guild verificationdiscord.com/privacy

Google AdSense uses cookies and device identifiers to serve ads. For users in the EEA, UK, and Switzerland, personalised advertising requires your consent via our cookie consent banner (powered by Google Funding Choices). Non-personalised ads are served if you decline. See our Cookie Policy for full details.

4. Data Retention

Session cookies expire after 7 days. Activity logs (IP hashes) are kept for 90 days and then purged. Forum posts and submissions are retained for as long as the site operates or until you request deletion. Discord profile data (username, avatar) is refreshed on each login and removed if you request account deletion.

5. Your Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, rectify, erase, or restrict processing of your personal data. EEA/UK residents have these rights under the GDPR / UK GDPR. To exercise any right, contact us on Discord at discord.gg/macrostack or open a thread in the support channel with your Discord user ID. We will respond within 30 days.

You may delete your account data at any time by contacting us. Deleting your account removes stored favorites, submissions, and forum posts attributed to your Discord ID. IP hashes are anonymised by design and cannot be individually deleted.

6. Legal Basis for Processing (EEA / UK)

  • Legitimate interest — anonymous view/download counting and deduplication using irreversible IP hashes.
  • Contract performance — storing your Discord identity to provide favorites, forum participation, and submission attribution.
  • Consent — personalised advertising cookies (you can withdraw consent at any time via the cookie banner).
  • Legal obligation — retaining abuse/scan logs to detect and prevent malicious uploads.

7. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page will reflect any changes. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance.

cookies:
1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember information about your visit, such as whether you are logged in. Some cookies are essential for the site to function; others are used for analytics or advertising.

2. Cookies We Set

paste-co.de sets the following first-party cookies:

Cookie namePurposeDurationType
pcd_discord_sessionStores your encrypted login session (Discord JWT) so you stay logged in across page loads.7 daysEssential
pcd_discord_oauth_stateCSRF protection token used during the Discord login flow. Deleted immediately after login completes.10 minutesEssential
pcd_discord_oauth_redirectRemembers the page you were on before being redirected to Discord login, so you are returned there after authenticating.10 minutesEssential

Additionally, your theme preference, right-panel collapsed state, anonymous display name, and Discord prompt acknowledgement are stored in localStorage (not a cookie). This data never leaves your device.

3. Third-Party Cookies

The following third-party services may set cookies on your device. We do not control these cookies.

4. Your Consent (EEA, UK & Switzerland)

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland, we are required to obtain your consent before setting non-essential cookies (such as those used for personalised advertising).

When you first visit the site you will be shown a consent banner powered by Google Funding Choices, a certified Consent Management Platform (CMP). You can:

  • Accept all — personalised ads are shown.
  • Reject / manage — only non-personalised ads are shown; no ad-related cookies are stored.

You can change or withdraw your consent at any time by clearing your browser cookies and reloading the site, which will show the banner again.

5. Managing Cookies in Your Browser

You can block or delete cookies at any time through your browser settings. Note that blocking essential cookies will prevent login from working correctly.

safety:
Overview

paste-co.de hosts files submitted by community members. All submissions go through a human admin review queue before being published. This page explains our review process and your responsibilities as a downloader.

Review Process

When a project is submitted, it enters a pending queue only visible to admins. An admin will inspect the submission — checking the link, description, and metadata — before approving and publishing it to the archive.

Submissions that contain malicious content, violate our Terms of Service, or are otherwise inappropriate will be rejected and deleted without notice.

Your Responsibility as a Downloader

You download and run files entirely at your own risk. We strongly recommend:

  • Running downloaded files in a virtual machine or sandbox before executing on your main system.
  • Scanning files with your own antivirus software before opening them.
  • Reading the project description and checking any linked source code before downloading.
  • Never running any executable you do not understand.

Reporting Malicious Content

If you believe a file on paste-co.de is malicious or harmful, please report it immediately in our Discord server. Include the project name, URL, and a description of your concern. We will investigate and remove the file if confirmed.

Disclaimer

paste-co.de and its operators disclaim all liability for any harm resulting from files downloaded from this site. All content is provided for educational purposes only. See our Terms of Service for full details.
